# viajante

Local Google Flights, Google Hotels, and Booking.com search. No API keys.
Fetch locale is English. User prompts may be any language. No implied home hub.

## Install (agents)

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "viajante": {
      "command": "uvx",
      "args": [
        "--from",
        "git+https://github.com/felipebasurto/viajante.git[mcp]",
        "viajante-mcp"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

After PyPI publishes, `--from viajante[mcp]`. Sweep and Google Hotels need no Chromium.
Detail scrape and Booking.com need both extras in the **same** uvx environment:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "viajante": {
      "command": "uvx",
      "args": [
        "--from",
        "git+https://github.com/felipebasurto/viajante.git[mcp,browser]",
        "viajante-mcp"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

```bash
uvx --from 'git+https://github.com/felipebasurto/viajante.git[mcp,browser]' playwright install chromium
```

Installing `viajante[browser]` elsewhere does not update the uvx environment.

## Tools

Every result (except lookup_airports) opens with an envelope: status, completeness, empty_reason (provider_empty | filtered_out | not_loaded), retry_after, observed_at. Only provider_empty means "none found".

- search_flights: named routes and dates
- search_dates: cheapest-per-day calendar (cheapest week). Max 31 days.
- search_flex: ±N around one date, then one shop. Not a date matrix.
- search_explore: dest triage from a named origin
- search_hotels: total-stay prices. Currency required. Default source google.
- search_trip: flights then hotels. Same currency. Default hotel source google.
- lookup_airports: offline city or IATA lookup. Does not pick a hub.
- recheck_offer: one fresh Google Flights search (never cached) that matches an earlier
  offer by flight numbers and departure times. Outcomes: same_price, price_changed,
  not_found, multiple_matches (no pick, no verdict), incomplete_identity (no search
  sent), check_failed, and substituted only with allow_substitute. check_failed
  (blocked, rate limited, incomplete offers, any provider error; check_completed false)
  means the check did not run to an answer, not that the offer is gone. allow_loose_match
  opts in to carrier plus times. A price_cap in the query is reported as
  filter_violations. currency must be the offer's own. Re-check finalists
  before presenting them as current. Not a booking guarantee; confirm the price on
  the provider's own page.
- search_hidden_city: Skiplagged, opt-in. Cards are USD; omit currency or pass USD. Do not copy a Google/origin quote keep (GBP, JPY, …).
- compare_awards: local award vs cash math. No live award seats.
- lookup_transfers: local transfer-partner table for a named program.
- verify_answer: flags amounts, codes, dates, and links in a draft reply that no
  search in this process returned.
- price_history: local read of this machine's recorded observations (opt-in via
  VIAJANTE_PRICE_HISTORY=1). One series per exact query and currency: first/last/
  lowest/highest and change since previous. One observation means no trend. No
  forecast, no currency comparison.
- watch_price: re-run one saved search_flights/search_hotels query on demand and
  report the change vs its last observation. No notifications, no scheduler; do
  not loop it (Google rate-limits). A cached or failed run records nothing.
- validate_itinerary: local pass/fail/unknown check of selected offers against
  named constraints (layovers, stay length, bags). Unknown never becomes pass.

- get_guide: the long operational guide (markdown); same text as the `viajante://guide` resource.

One search at a time in the MCP process. Every tool has a title and read-only
annotations; only the search tools are open-world. Bad input fails the call with
JSON text `{"error": {"code": "invalid_parameter", "field": ..., "message": ...}}`
after the SDK's exact `Error executing tool <name>: ` prefix (`field` null when not provable). Needs `mcp>=1.14.1`.

Local HTTP (opt-in, no auth): `viajante-mcp --transport streamable-http` serves
`http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp`; client entry `{"mcpServers": {"viajante": {"url": "http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp"}}}`.
A non-loopback `--host` warns: every client searches from this machine's IP and
shares its provider cooldown.

Rate limits: a Google HTTP 429 pauses Google searches on this machine for a
cooldown (error `rate_limited: true`; its message names the UTC time to wait
until, and `retry_after` / `retry_after_seconds` repeat it when a cooldown was recorded). Tell the user to wait; do not retry. Identical successful
searches within 5 minutes return `cached: true` without a new request.

## Currency

Pass `currency` (ISO 4217) or infer from a named origin airport country
(JFK USD, LHR GBP, NRT JPY, GRU BRL). Hotels have no origin: currency is required.
Skiplagged hidden-city keep is USD/omit; other keeps are `currency_mismatch` (no FX).
Do not invent IATA, gl, or ISO 4217. Viajante does not convert.

## Bags

Unnamed baggage_buffer is 0. Prefer bags / carry_on on the shopping request.
Do not invent a bag fee.

## Python

```python
from viajante import get_flights, search_flights, SearchErrorCode, QueryFailure

report = get_flights("JFK-LHR:YYYY-MM-DD", fetch="sweep")
```

Sweep `proxy` covers flights, dates, flex, and explore. Hotels have no proxy flag.
Signatures: `src/viajante/mcp_server.py`.
